newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa futures called to open flat to down $10.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa futures called to open flat to down $10.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open unchanged to $10 lower Thursday following a weak performance in London overnight, traders said.
By the midday break, May LIFFE cocoa futures eased three stg to 1,014 stg as trade remained confined to a narrow range.

New York cocoa futures settled weaker Wednesday as the May/July switch remained in the spotlight. Spot May cocoa ended down $14 at $1,400 a tonne, with active July $16 lower at $1,439 after posting trades from $1,457 to $1,435. The outer months lost $14 to $16.
May's discount to second-month July pulled back to $39 at the close, down from $41 on Tuesday.
Technically, July near-term support was seen at last Friday's low of $1,433. To the upside, resistance was pegged at $1,457-$1,459, with a large chart gap looming at $1,480-1,504.
The U.S. first-quarter grind data is slated for release on Friday at 0845 EDT. Analysts' grind forecasts ranged from flat to up five percent.
